unresolved: Issue #22 reservation accounting (atomic capacity reservation, measured-usage reconciliation, token/cost allocation, retry/cancellation races, budget re-anchoring on reopen/resume) is future work — this session delivers the shared concurrency semaphore, deadlines, depth cap and nested cancellation
Cancellation is cooperative: a started handler cannot be interrupted; its result is discarded uncommitted and the drain waits for it (a handler that never returns would stall the drain)
Budgets are not re-instated on resume; a resumed run continues without its original budget
Fairness (one child cannot monopolize the tree) is not scheduled; the shared semaphore is not FIFO
